input.free_text_description: This system is a file management platform that serves Operator roles. The platform provides capabilities for comm with agv handler. Secondary concerns include IoT functionality.

user_stories.story: As a Operator, I want to use comm with agv handler capabilities, so that I can perform essential business operations.
As a Operator, I want to access the system through a well-defined interface, so that I can perform my tasks efficiently.
As a Operator, I want to view a summary of my recent activity, so that I can track my progress.
As a Operator, I want to update my preferences and settings, so that the system adapts to my needs.
As a Operator, I want to export data in a standard format, so that I can use it in external tools.
